verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents selectable transcription models: model=nova-3 for recorded files and flux-general-multi for multilingual conversation, plus a models-and-languages overview. That shows developers can choose among models. The pack has no published per-model accuracy benchmarks, latency figures or per-model pricing, so the tradeoff part of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: published accuracy/WER comparisons across models, documented latency per model, per-model cost tradeoffs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose among documented transcription models with published accuracy, latency, and cost tradeoffs
